Class ItemLists

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.ItemLists
public final class ItemLists extends Object
Items an admin sets in a menu as a list (API_VERSION 29): a row per item with its icon, name, how many and an X to take it out, and one "Add an item..." dropdown (type to search) that adds the item picked. The page keeps the items as it always did, one line such as "Ingredient_Bar_Gold x5, Food_Bread x10" (Rewards.parseItems(String)). 
// build(): the list's rows and its Add dropdown, in an empty Group #RewardItems of your page
ItemLists.draw(cmd, events, "#RewardItems", draft.getItems(), "Action", "Id", "@Text", "@Number", "reward");
// handleDataEvent(): "ItemAdd", "ItemRemove" and "ItemAmount" come with Id "reward" or "reward:2"
if (ItemLists.handles(data.action)) {
    draft.setItems(ItemLists.change(draft.getItems(), data.action, data.id, data.text, data.number));
    if (ItemLists.redraws(data.action)) ItemLists.draw(...);
}
A pick ("ItemAdd") or an X ("ItemRemove") draws the list again; a count ("ItemAmount") does not, so the cursor stays. The same item picked twice is one row with both counts. At most Rewards.MAX_KINDS kinds of item.

    • change

      public static String change(String line, String action, String where, String text, Double number)
      The line after an event of its rows: "ItemAdd" (text is the item picked), "ItemRemove" or "ItemAmount" (number is the new count). where is "list" or "list:row". Other actions, or a bad row, return the line as it was.

    • change

      public static String change(String line, String action, String where, String text, Double number, com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory.ItemStack held)
      The same, and "The item in your hand" (HAND) adds held exactly as it is: an enchanted item (or one with another mod's data) is kept by Core (ItemData.keep(ItemStack)) and the line holds its token. An item ItemData.problem(ItemStack) refuses (a backpack that is not empty...) is not added; ask it for the reason. API 33.

      Draws a list into an empty group of the page: a row per item and, while there is room, the Add dropdown.
      Parameters:
      box - the group, such as "#RewardItems"
      keyAction - the page's key for its action ("Action"), keyId for the id ("Id"), keyText for a text ("@Text"), keyNumber for a number ("@Number")
      list - the list's name in the events' id
